target: SP11 milestone M1 (docs/SP11-MONITOR-PORT.md section 2): the A16 monitor on the Surface Pro 11 boot CPU, six vCPU records with one released, the stock J700 kernel
qualification: Build recipe only. Compile-checked on the host, never run on a Surface Pro 11 (hardware NOT RUN). A boot needs the operator's authorisation of the monitor's SHA-256 (docs/SP11-MONITOR-PORT.md section 12).

required_input.meaning: path of a header written by tools/nv2_record.py; which measurement to embed is operator decision D6 and is never chosen here

runtime_contract.x4_meaning: no host secondary configuration, so no physical secondary is started
runtime_contract.early_stop_thermal_meaning: compat/a16-thermal.c reads A16 physical addresses; EARLY_STOP_F_THERMAL must stay clear in the launch parameters
